scope: one fresh browser auction funded, cleared and settled on standard public Zcash testnet (NU7) through the demo API; synthetic demo bids; every party on one host
implementation_commit: ecceac8 (SDK testnet transport, testnet drivers and settle_fresh_book --chain testnet as of that commit)

network.name: Zcash standard testnet
network.provider: https://testnet.zec.rocks:443 (lightwalletd v0.5.4, commit c22ca9ba, protocol v0.5.0)
network.provider_trust: chain data comes from one trusted lightwalletd provider over validated TLS; the SDK re-checks chain name, genesis and NU7 branch on every connection and the scanner checks every block Ironwood tree size and the final frontier root; no SPV or consensus validation by DarkCall itself

funding_of_local_test_bank.source: testnet faucet transfer arranged by the author
funding_of_local_test_bank.note: testnet coins only; the bank key never left .local

settlement.outputs: seller 63, refunds 79/79/79/100 with encrypted receipts, operator fee 30000

limitations: every party runs on one host; the local helper sees the typed demo bids
deposits for all four tickets come from one local test bank, not four bidder wallets
REP3 assumes at most one semi-honest corrupt operator; two colluding FROST signers can move escrowed funds
admission signatures attest funding; they are not a public ZK funding proof; the public bundle does not prove chain inclusion
confirmations were observed through one trusted lightwalletd provider
demo-sized amounts: 100-zatoshi budget and 15,000-zatoshi processing fee per ticket
